title: Italian-Style Strawberry Shortcake
description: This Italian-style strawberry shortcake recipe is a layered dessert with fresh strawberries, cream, mascarpone, and cake, all soaked in a light syrup.
ingredients: 0.33333334326744 cup white sugar, or to taste
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
1 (10 inch) prepared angel food cake, torn into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Reserve a few pretty strawberry slices for garnish; place remaining strawberries in a bowl and sprinkle with sugar. Set aside until sugar melts and berries release juices, about 10 minutes.

Combine mascarpone and whipped topping in a separate bowl. Place cake pieces in a trifle dish; spread strawberries and juice over top. Top with mascarpone cream; decorate with reserved strawberry slices. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

video.description: Angel food cake crumbles and layers of sweet mascarpone and whipped cream are a dream dessert! Layer up in a deep glass bowl to see the beautiful layers of refreshing strawberry, decadent whipped cream, and fluffy cake pieces.
